description: A historical file of building permits from the City of Dallas, published on Dallas OpenData. The page says the dataset is no longer updated and that active permit tracking has moved to the city's Accela Citizen Access portal; it was last updated in August 2020. Each of its 126,840 rows (when read) gives a permit number, type, issued date, Mapsco grid reference, contractor, value, area, work description, land use, street address and zip code. Coverage: the city of Dallas. Format and access: free Excel or CSV file and Socrata API; no licence is stated. Caveats: the data stop in 2020, so it is only a historical reference for permitted construction value and land use by address. Useful for baseline analyses of construction activity and building stock change in capacity planning simulation; related records are not yet linked.
